name: r3a1-address-whole-object-hash-integrity
description: R3a-1 Outcome 1 whole-object read: every page must report the hash of the whole original, not of the page it carries, so a client can verify that the reassembled document equals the stored original. internal/address/address.go Read sets `WholeHash: canon.Hash(original)` from the full original bytes. Weakening that to hash only the current page makes a multi-page read report a hash that depends on the page cut and no longer equals the original. The existing evidence-backed test TestReadReassemblesPagesToWholeOriginalHash compares each page's WholeHash against WholeHash(original) and the reassembled concatenation against the original hash.
baseline_meaning: On the unmutated tree every page of a multi-page read reports WholeHash(original), and the concatenation of all pages hashes to the same whole-original hash as the stored object.
mutant_meaning: With the whole-object hash weakened to WholeHash(page.Data) the first page of a cut read reports the hash of its 7-byte slice instead of the whole original, so TestReadReassemblesPagesToWholeOriginalHash fails the per-page whole-hash comparison (RED). The mutant is therefore killed by the registered probe, not vacuous.
runner: tests/contracts/mutation-runner/main.go executes this case from tests/contracts/mutation-registry.json under the GO_UNIT harness for the invariant entry `acceptance.r3a1.address.whole-object-hash-integrity`; the identical case is committed both here and in the registry so the proof is pinned to the product guard.
